not_found.consequence: No unit-level internal dimensioned drawings with bounding wall faces; prevents automated generation of tier D-SURVEYED unit geometry.
Full building architectural vertical section sheet with dimensioned floor-to-floor heights not present; relied on CC elevation anchors in metres.
Commencement certificate heights are given above AGL / Mt. Level; tying to Town Hall Datum (THD) requires MCGM DP Remarks.

anomalies.description: Floor Count and Superstructure Reporting Evolution: Commencement Certificate EB/947/GS/A sanctions construction up to 60 floors (213.95m), Architect Form 1 reports 58 slabs of superstructure, Part 1 OCC covers up to 57th floor, Part 2 OCC covers 58th floor and 59th service floor, and IOD reflects a total of 60 floors including crown/LMR.
anomalies.significance: Highlights progressive vertical completion milestones where physical slabs, habitable floors, and service/LMR levels differ across statutory stages.

anomalies.description: Cadastral Survey Number Consolidation under Mill Land DCR 58: Historic textile mill property encompassing 52,400.89 sq.m across Old CS Nos. 1/433, 434, 435, 1/435, 470, 471, 472 was reconstituted into New CS No. 434 and tripartite-divided into Sub-Plot A (22,065.28 sq.m private), MCGM RG Plot 1A/434 (6,193.68 sq.m), and MHADA Plot 1C/434 (5,067.78 sq.m).
anomalies.significance: Crucial for parcel identity reconciliation; ensures 3D-ULPIN links Tower I strictly to Sub-Plot A under New CS 434.

anomalies.description: Total Unit Sanction vs Sold Inventory Count: Architectural IOD BUA summary designs for 272 total residential tenements in Tower A & B, whereas MahaRERA disclosure documents 238 units sold/booked as of 31 March 2022.
anomalies.significance: Demonstrates 34 unsold units remaining in developer inventory at the time of filing.

something_new.description: High-Rise Elevation Progression via 7 CC Metre Anchors: The municipal Commencement Certificate EB/947/GS/A provides seven sequential height endorsements in metres (+6.80m, +3.90m, +4.20m, +33.95m, +171.05m, +181.55m, and +213.95m), enabling precise vertical georeferencing without relying on assumed floor heights.

Multi-Level Integrated Podium Parking Facility: A dedicated 772-bay covered vehicle storage network distributed across 9 distinct levels (P0 stilt with 416 bays, P1 podium with 206 bays, and 5 upper parking floors CP1-CP5a accommodating 150 bays).

DCR 58 Tripartite Urban Mill Land Reconstitution: Transformation of the Prakash Cotton Mills industrial complex into private luxury residential development (Sub-Plot A), public open space (MCGM RG Plot), and public affordable housing (MHADA Plot).
